arabic text: Mein khuwaab mein Asghar tujhay, lori bhi\nsunaoon\nTujhay jhoola jhulaon, mein tujhay jhoola jhulaon
english translation text: In my dreams, Asghar, I will\nsing you lullabies, I will rock\nyour cradle; I will rock your cradle

arabic text: Laut aao safar sey ke badi deyr huwi hay\nBetaab hu kabsey tujhay seenay sey lagaoon
english translation text: Return from the journey—it has been so long;\nI have waited restlessly to hold you to my chest

arabic text: Koi mujhay batlata nahi teri nishani\nBarsaat mein teeroon ki kahan dhoondnay jaon
english translation text: No one tells me where to find any trace of you;\nwhere can I search for you amid the rain of arrows?

arabic text: Socha tha teri saalgirah ghar mein karoongi\nTaqdeer yeh kehti hay tera sog manaoon
english translation text: I had dreamed of celebrating your birthday at home;\nfate now tells me to mourn you

arabic text: Baba say teray tera janaza na uthayga\nRuk ja zara Abbas ko dariya sey bulaon
english translation text: Your father will not be able to lift your funeral bier;\nwait a moment while I call Abbas from the river

arabic text:
Yeh Khoon mein bhara kurta, yeh matti mein
bharay baal
Seenay mein chupaon ke mein aankhoon sey
lagaoon
english translation text:
This blood-soaked shirt, these hair
filled with dust— should I
hide them against my chest, or
press them to my eyes?

arabic text: Iss tarha Koi rooth ke maa sey nahi jata\nTu Khud he bata dey mein tujhay kaisay\nmanaoon
english translation text: No child leaves his mother in such anger;\ntell me yourself, how can I persuade\nyou to return?

arabic text: Rehan ke nohay sey sada baano ki ayee\nMein aankhoon sey askhkoon ke samander ko\nbahaoon
english translation text: Through "Rehan's" lament came Bano's voice:\nI will make oceans of tears\nflow from my eyes
